description: Test whether a domain's authoritative name servers allow a DNS zone transfer (AXFR) — a classic misconfiguration that leaks the entire zone (every hostname it holds) to anyone who asks (RFC 5936: AXFR must be limited to authorised secondaries). Returns a per-name-server verdict — 'transferred' (leaked — the finding), 'refused'/'notauth' (declined, the safe default), 'timeout'/'unreachable', or 'blocked' (the NS resolved to an internal address and wasn't contacted) — with a sample of the disclosed records. Read-only external check over DNS/TCP; never touches the target's application.
name: zone_transfer_check
